name: add_address
description:
Creates a new address for an existing customer.

This function adds a new address to a customer's address collection. The address requires four mandatory fields (address1, city, country, zip) and supports optional fields for complete address information. The new address is automatically assigned a unique ID and set as non-default. Returns the complete created address with all provided and generated fields.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer to add the address to.

address.description: Input model for address data when creating a new address.

address2.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, etc.

description:
Closes an order.

Closes an order. A closed order is one that has no more work to be done. All items have been fulfilled or refunded.

description:

Retrieves the total number of orders that meet the specified criteria.

created_at_min.description: Count orders created at or after this date (ISO 8601 format).

name: create_an_order_transaction
description:
Creates a new transaction for a specified order.

This function creates a new transaction for a specified order. This can be used to record payments (such as 'sale' or 'capture') or authorizations. The details of the transaction, including its kind, amount, and optionally the gateway, are provided within the `transaction` dictionary.

The function performs comprehensive financial validation including: validates capture amounts against authorization limits, prevents over-refunding by checking transaction history, enforces proper transaction state transitions (e.g., can't void captured authorizations), automatically updates order financial status based on transaction outcomes, and manages customer gift card balance updates for manual gateway refunds (gift card refunds automatically credit the customer's gift card balance).

order_id.description: The ID of the order for which to create a transaction.

transaction.description: Input model for transaction data when creating a new transaction.

amount.description: The amount of the transaction. Must be a positive decimal value.

gateway.description: The payment gateway used. For manual payments, can be 'manual'. Optional for some kinds like capture/void if parent_id is used.

parent_id.description: The ID of an existing transaction to explicitly void or capture.

currency.description: The currency (ISO 4217 format) of the transaction. Defaults to order currency.

test.description: Whether this is a test transaction. Default: false.

authorization.description: The authorization code, for external gateways when kind is 'sale' or 'authorization'.

target_payment_method_id.description: The ID of the target payment method for cross-payment method refunds.

source_name.description: Source of the transaction (e.g., 'WEB', 'POS', 'API'). Defaults to 'API'.

payment_details.description: Payment details like card_token for receipt generation.

avs_result_code.description: AVS response code returned by the payment gateway.

credit_card_bin.description: Bank identification number of the credit card.

credit_card_company.description: Credit card brand such as Visa or Mastercard.

credit_card_number.description: Masked credit card number (for example XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-1234).

card_token.description: Token representing the payment card for receipt generation.

name: create_draft_order
description:
Creates a new draft order with comprehensive line items, customer data, and pricing calculations.

This function creates a complete draft order by processing line items, customer information,
shipping and billing addresses, applied discounts, and shipping details. The system automatically
calculates subtotals, applies line-item and order-level discounts, computes tax amounts, and
generates the final total price. When a variant_id is provided, product details are automatically
retrieved from the database, while custom line items can be created using title and price.
Customer data can reference existing customers by ID or create new customer records as needed.
The function handles complex discount logic including percentage and fixed-amount discounts at
both line-item and order levels, ensuring accurate pricing calculations throughout the process.

draft_order.description: Inner input model for draft order fields.

line_items.description: A list of line item objects that define the products or services in the draft order.

items.description: Input model for a line item in draft order creation.

variant_id.description: The unique identifier of an existing product variant. When provided, product details are automatically retrieved from the database.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the parent product. Used in conjunction with custom line items.

quantity.description: The number of units for this line item. Must be a positive integer.

title.description: The display name for custom line items. Required when variant_id is not provided.

price.description: The unit price for custom line items as a decimal string. Required when variant_id is not provided.

sku.description: The stock keeping unit identifier for inventory tracking.

grams.description: The weight of the line item in grams for shipping calculations.

requires_shipping.description: Whether this item needs physical shipping. Defaults to True for most items.

taxable.description: Whether this item is subject to tax calculations. Defaults to True for most items.

applied_discount.description: Applied discount for a line item in draft order input.

title.description: A descriptive name for the discount.

value.description: The discount amount as a decimal string.

value_type.description: Either 'fixed_amount' for dollar amounts or 'percentage' for percentage-based discounts.

custom_attributes.description: Additional metadata for the line item as key-value pairs.

name.description: Property key for the line item.

key.description: Key for the custom attribute. Required field.

value.description: Value for the custom attribute. Required field.

value_type.description: Optional type information describing the value.

customer.description: Input model for customer in draft order creation.

phone.description: Phone number associated with this entity.

id.description: The unique identifier of an existing customer. When provided, existing customer data is used.

email.description: The customer's email address for new customer records.

first_name.description: The customer's first name for new customer records.

last_name.description: The customer's last name for new customer records.

shipping_address.description: Input model for address in draft order creation.

phone.description: Phone number associated with this entity.

address2.description: Secondary address line for apartment or suite numbers.

billing_address.description: Input model for address in draft order creation.

phone.description: Phone number associated with this entity.

address2.description: Secondary address line for apartment or suite numbers.

email.description: Primary email address for the draft order. This is used when no customer object is provided or when the customer object lacks an email.

note.description: Internal notes or comments about the draft order for reference purposes.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags for categorizing and organizing draft orders.

shipping_line.description: Input model for shipping line in draft order creation.

title.description: The name of the shipping method (e.g., 'Standard Shipping').

price.description: The shipping cost as a decimal string.

applied_discount.description: Input model for order-level discount in draft order creation.

title.description: A descriptive name for the discount.

description.description: Additional details about the discount promotion.

value.description: The discount amount as a decimal string.

value_type.description: Either 'fixed_amount' for dollar discounts or 'percentage' for percentage-based discounts.

tax_exempt.description: Whether the entire draft order is exempt from tax calculations.

name: create_exchange
description:
Creates an exchange for items in an existing order.

Creates an Exchange object that allows customers to return fulfilled items and receive different items in return. Automatically calculates price differences, processes inventory adjustments, and completes the exchange immediately. Validates exchange eligibility by checking order status, fulfillment status, and inventory availability.

items.description: Input model for a single exchange return line item.

fulfillment_line_item_id.description: ID of the original order line item to exchange.

items.description: Input model for a single exchange new line item.

variant_id.description: ID of the product variant to receive.

product_id.description: ID of the product to receive.

price.description: Custom price for the item as decimal string.

restock_returned_items.description: Whether to restock the returned items (default: True).

name: create_order
description:
Creates an order with comprehensive customer, financial, and inventory management.

This endpoint creates complete orders with detailed line items, customer linking, address management,
financial processing including gift card payments, and inventory control. The system supports both
existing and new customer creation, automatic transaction processing, and flexible inventory behavior
policies for different fulfillment scenarios.

line_items.description: A list of line items that make up the order.

items.description: Input model for line items in order creation.

variant_id.description: Product variant ID to order. Required if product_id not provided.

quantity.description: Number of units to order. Must be a positive integer.

price.description: Override price per unit as decimal string. Uses variant price if not provided.

title.description: Override line item display name. Uses variant/product title if not provided.

total_discount_amount.description: Total discount for entire line (not per unit) as decimal string. Example: '10.00' for $10 total discount on this line item.

requires_shipping.description: Whether this item requires shipping. Defaults to True for most items.

taxable.description: Whether this item is subject to tax. Defaults to True for most items.

gift_card.description: Whether this item is a gift card. Defaults to False.

grams.description: Weight of the line item in grams for shipping calculations.

fulfillment_status.description: Enum for fulfillment status filter in get orders count.

admin_graphql_api_id.description: GraphQL API identifier for the line item.

total_discount.description: Total discount amount for this line as decimal string.

line_price.description: Total price for this line (quantity * price).

phone.description: Phone number associated with this entity.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer this address belongs to.

name: create_return
description:
Initiates a return for one or more line items on an order.

Creates a Return object and associated ReturnLineItem objects for items that have been fulfilled but need to be returned. Validates return eligibility by checking fulfillment status, existing return quantities, and order state to ensure proper inventory tracking.

items.description: Input model for a single return line item.

name: get_address
description:
Retrieves a specific customer address using customer ID and address ID.

This function fetches a single address from a customer's address collection. You need both the customer ID and the specific address ID to retrieve the address. Returns complete address details including contact information and geographic data.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer who owns the address.

address_id.description: The unique identifier of the specific address to retrieve.

name: get_customer_by_id
description:
Retrieves a single customer by their unique identifier with optional field selection.

This endpoint fetches complete customer information for a specific customer ID. You can optimize the response by requesting only specific fields, which is useful for reducing payload size when you only need certain customer attributes. The function returns comprehensive customer data including personal information, order statistics, addresses, and account metadata.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer. Must be a non-empty string representing the customer's ID in the system.

fields.description: Specific customer fields to include in the response. Each field name must be a valid customer attribute. Supports nested field access for addresses.

name: get_customer_orders
description:
Retrieves all orders belonging to a specific customer with comprehensive filtering and field selection capabilities.

This endpoint provides access to a customer's complete order history with flexible filtering options including order status, creation date ranges, and financial status. By default, only open orders are returned to focus on active business. The function supports field-level response customization to optimize payload size and includes comprehensive order details including line items, pricing, and customer information for each returned order.

created_at_max.description: Filter orders created before this date. Must be in ISO 8601 format with timezone information.

created_at_min.description: Filter orders created after this date. Must be in ISO 8601 format with timezone information.

financial_status.description: Filter orders by their payment and financial processing status. Examples: 'pending' (awaiting payment), 'paid' (fully paid), 'partially_paid' (partial payment received), 'refunded' (payment returned), 'voided' (payment cancelled). Default is None (no financial status filtering).

status.description: Enum for order status in get orders count.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer whose orders should be retrieved. Must be a non-empty string representing a valid customer ID in the system.

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return in a single response. Must be between 1 and 250 for performance optimization. Default is 50.

fields.description: Specific order fields to include in each response object. Reduces payload size when only certain data is needed. Default is None (all available fields).

name: get_draft_order_by_id
description:
Retrieves a specific draft order using its unique identifier.

This function fetches a complete draft order by ID with optional field filtering to reduce response size.
When fields parameter is provided, only the specified fields are returned. Otherwise, the complete
draft order with all available data is returned including pricing, customer info, line items, and status.

draft_order_id.description: The unique identifier of the draft order to retrieve.

fields.description: Specific fields to include in the response for optimized payload size.

name: get_order_by_id
description:
Retrieves an order by specifying the ID. All fields of an order are returned unless specific fields are named.

When the 'fields' parameter is provided with a non-empty list, only the specified fields are returned.
When 'fields' is omitted, None, or an empty list, all available fields are returned.

order_id.description: The ID of the order to retrieve. This is a path parameter.

fields.description: A list of field names to retrieve for the order. If omitted or an empty list, all fields are returned.

name: get_product_by_id
description:
Retrieves a specific product by its ID.

This function retrieves detailed information for a single product identified by its unique `product_id`.
An optional list of `fields` can be provided to limit the data returned for the product.

product_id.description: The ID of the product to retrieve. This is a path parameter.

fields.description: A list of fields to retrieve for the product. If provided, must contain at least one field.

name: list_addresses
description:
Retrieves a list of addresses for a specific customer with result limiting.

This endpoint fetches addresses associated with a customer account, providing comprehensive address information including shipping and billing details. The function implements result limiting to control response size for efficient data transfer. Each address includes complete geographic and contact information, making it suitable for order processing, shipping calculations, and customer profile management. Addresses are sorted lexicographically by ID to ensure consistent ordering, while the limit parameter allows you to control how many addresses are returned (up to 250), useful for managing large address collections.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer whose addresses should be retrieved.

limit.description: The maximum number of address records to return. Must be between 1 and 250.

name: list_customers
description:
Retrieves a filtered list of customers with support for date ranges, field selection, and pagination.

This endpoint provides comprehensive customer listing capabilities with multiple filtering options including creation and update date ranges, specific customer ID selection, and field-level response customization. The function supports result limiting for efficient data retrieval. You can optimize response payload by requesting only specific customer fields, making it ideal for bulk customer operations and data synchronization tasks.

created_at_max.description: Filter customers created before this date. Must be in ISO 8601 format with timezone.

created_at_min.description: Filter customers created after this date. Must be in ISO 8601 format with timezone.

fields.description: Specific customer fields to include in each response object.

limit.description: Maximum number of customers to return. Must be between 1 and 250.

updated_at_max.description: Filter customers last updated before this date. Must be in ISO 8601 format with timezone.

updated_at_min.description: Filter customers last updated after this date. Must be in ISO 8601 format with timezone.

name: list_draft_orders
description:
Retrieves a filtered list of draft orders with support for pagination and field selection.

This function fetches draft orders from the system with comprehensive filtering options including
date ranges, specific IDs, status filtering, and field selection. Supports pagination via limit parameter for efficient data retrieval. When fields parameter is provided, only specified
fields are returned to optimize response size. Returns draft orders sorted by ID for consistent pagination.

fields.description: Specific fields to include in each draft order for optimized payload size.

limit.description: Maximum number of draft orders to return in a single response. Must be between 1 and 250 inclusive.

updated_at_min.description: Include draft orders last updated at or after this timestamp (ISO 8601 format).

updated_at_max.description: Include draft orders last updated at or before this timestamp (ISO 8601 format).

ids.description: Specific draft order IDs to retrieve for targeted data access.

name: list_orders
description:
Retrieves a list of orders that meet the specified criteria. Note: This endpoint implements pagination by using links that are provided in the response header.

Filters can be applied based on creation date, update date, processed date, financial
status, fulfillment_status, overall order status, order IDs, order name, and app attribution.
The function supports field-level response customization to optimize payload size.

created_at_max.description: Count orders created at or before this date (ISO 8601 format).

created_at_min.description: Count orders created at or after this date (ISO 8601 format).

financial_status.description: Enum for financial status filter in get orders count.

status.description: Enum for order status in get orders count.

updated_at_max.description: Count orders last updated at or before this date (ISO 8601 format).

updated_at_min.description: Count orders last updated at or after this date (ISO 8601 format).

fulfillment_status.description: Enum for fulfillment status filter in get orders count.

attribution_app_id.description: Show orders attributed to a certain app, specified by the app ID. Set as 'current' to show orders for the app currently consuming the API.

fields.description: A list of field names to retrieve for each order. These will be sent as a comma-separated string to the API.

ids.description: A list of order IDs to retrieve. These will be sent as a comma-separated string to the API.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to show on a page. Must be less than or equal to 250. Default: 50.

processed_at_max.description: Show orders imported or processed at or before this date (ISO 8601 format).

processed_at_min.description: Show orders imported or processed at or after this date (ISO 8601 format).

name: list_products
description:
Retrieves a list of products with comprehensive filtering and pagination support.

This function provides access to the store's product catalog with extensive filtering capabilities
including collection membership, date ranges, product types, and field selection. Supports
real-world result limiting for efficient data retrieval.

collection_id.description: Return products belonging to a specific product collection ID. Supports both manual collections (explicit product lists) and smart collections (rule-based automatic inclusion based on product attributes like type, vendor, tags, etc.).

created_at_max.description: Return products created before a specified date (ISO 8601 format).

created_at_min.description: Return products created after a specified date (ISO 8601 format).

fields.description: A list of field names to retrieve for each product. Available fields include: admin_graphql_api_id, body_html, created_at, handle, id, image, images, options, product_type, published_at, published_scope, status, tags, template_suffix, title, updated_at, variants, vendor. If None or empty, all available fields are returned.

handle.description: A list of product handles to retrieve. Handles are human-friendly unique strings used in URLs and themes.

ids.description: A list of product IDs to retrieve. Useful for fetching specific products.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to retrieve per page. Default: 50, Maximum: 250.

presentment_currencies.description: A list of ISO 4217 currency codes to return presentment prices in. When provided, each variant will include a 'presentment_prices' array with currency-specific pricing. Supported currencies: USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY.

product_type.description: Filter products by product type. Case-insensitive matching.

published_at_max.description: Return products published before a specified date (ISO 8601 format).

published_at_min.description: Return products published after a specified date (ISO 8601 format).

name: modify_pending_order_address
description:
Modifies the shipping address of an open order.

Updates the delivery address for an open order that hasn't been fulfilled yet.
This function allows modification of shipping information while preserving
payment and line item details.

order_id.description: The ID of the order to modify.

shipping_address.description: Input model for shipping address in shopster_modify_pending_order_address.

phone.description: Phone number associated with this entity.

name: modify_pending_order_items
description:
Modifies line items and related charges of an open order.

Updates line items, shipping charges, tax lines, discount codes, and order notes
for an open order that hasn't been fulfilled yet. This function allows modification
of order items while preserving address and payment details.

order_id.description: The ID of the order to modify.

line_items.description: A list of dictionaries, where each dictionary represents a specific line item modification for the order.

items.description: Input model for a single line item in shopster_modify_pending_order_items.

variant_id.description: Variant ID to update or add.

quantity.description: New quantity (0 to remove the item).

payment_method_id.description: The payment method to use for the order.

name: modify_pending_order_payment
description:
Modifies payment transactions of an open order.

Updates or adds payment transactions for an open order that hasn't been fulfilled yet.
This function allows modification of payment information while preserving address
and line item details.

order_id.description: The ID of the order to modify.

transactions.description: A list of dictionaries, where each dictionary represents a single payment transaction to be updated or added to the order.

items.description: Input model for a single transaction in shopster_modify_pending_order_payment.

amount.description: Transaction amount as decimal string.

test.description: Whether this is a test transaction.

receipt.description: Input model for transaction receipt in shopster_modify_pending_order_payment.

card_last_four.description: Last four digits of the card.

error_code.description: Gateway error code if the transaction failed.

currency_exchange_adjustment.description: Model for currency exchange adjustments on transactions.

adjustment.description: The difference between original and final amount due to exchange rate changes.

name: reopen_order
description:
Re-opens a closed order.

This function re-opens a previously closed order. It takes the ID of the closed order as input. Upon successful execution, it returns a dictionary containing the updated order details, reflecting its reopened status. The order's closed_at field is set to null and the updated_at timestamp is updated to reflect the reopening action.

order_id.description: The ID of the closed order to re-open. This is a path parameter.

name: search_customers
description:
Searches for customers using flexible query syntax with support for filtering, pagination, and field selection.

This endpoint enables powerful customer search capabilities using Shopster's query language syntax. You can search by customer attributes like email, name, phone, tags, order count, and dates. The function supports cursor-based pagination for handling large result sets and allows selective field retrieval to optimize response size. Results can be sorted by various customer fields in ascending or descending order.

query.description: The search query string using Shopster query syntax.

limit.description: Maximum number of customer results to retrieve. Must be between 1 and 250.

fields.description: Specific customer fields to include in the response. Supports nested field access using dot notation.

order.description: Sort order specification in format 'field_name DIRECTION'. Field must be a valid sortable customer field (id, email, first_name, last_name, orders_count, state, total_spent, created_at, updated_at), direction must be 'ASC' or 'DESC' (case-insensitive).

name: search_products
description:
Search products with comprehensive filtering and sorting capabilities.

This function provides advanced product search functionality with support for text search,
tag filtering, price ranges, inventory levels, and multiple sorting options. Designed for
real-world e-commerce scenarios where customers need to find products based on specific
attributes and criteria.

query.description: Text search query to match against product title, body_html, tags, vendor, and product_type. Case-insensitive partial matching.

tags.description: List of tags that products must have. Products must contain ALL specified tags (AND logic). Tags are matched case-insensitively.

product_type.description: Filter by product type. Case-insensitive exact match.

vendor.description: Filter by vendor name. Case-insensitive exact match.

price_min.description: Minimum price filter. Searches across all product variants. Format: decimal string (e.g., '10.00', '99.99').

price_max.description: Maximum price filter. Searches across all product variants. Format: decimal string (e.g., '100.00', '999.99').

inventory_quantity_min.description: Minimum total inventory quantity across all variants.

inventory_quantity_max.description: Maximum total inventory quantity across all variants.

created_at_min.description: Filter products created after this date (ISO 8601 format).

created_at_max.description: Filter products created before this date (ISO 8601 format).

updated_at_min.description: Filter products updated after this date (ISO 8601 format).

updated_at_max.description: Filter products updated before this date (ISO 8601 format).

variant_query.description: Text search query to match against variant titles, SKUs, and option values. Case-insensitive partial matching.

variant_sku.description: Filter products that have variants with matching SKU. Case-insensitive partial matching.

variant_title.description: Filter products that have variants with matching title. Case-insensitive partial matching.

variant_option1.description: Filter products that have variants with matching option1 value. Case-insensitive partial matching.

variant_option2.description: Filter products that have variants with matching option2 value. Case-insensitive partial matching.

variant_option3.description: Filter products that have variants with matching option3 value. Case-insensitive partial matching.

fields.description: List of fields to include in response. If provided, must contain at least one field. If not specified, returns all product fields.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return. Range: 1-250. Default: 50.

sort_by.description: Enum for sort_by parameter in shopster_search_products.

sort_order.description: Enum for sort_order parameter in shopster_search_products.

name: transfer_to_human_agents
description:
Transfer the user to a human agent with a summary of the user's issue.

This function facilitates the transfer to a human agent. It should only be used
if the user explicitly asks for a human agent, or if the user's issue cannot
be resolved by the agent with the available tools.

summary.description: A concise description of the user's issue to share with a human agent.

name: update_address
description:
Updates an existing customer address with partial field modifications.

This function modifies specific fields of an existing address within a customer's address collection. Only the fields you provide in the address parameter will be updated - other fields remain unchanged. The system prevents modification of protected fields (id, customer_id, default) to maintain data integrity. Returns the complete updated address with all current field values.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer whose address is being updated.

address_id.description: The unique identifier of the specific address to update.

address.description: Input model for partial address updates when updating an existing address.

name: update_draft_order
description:
Updates an existing draft order with the provided fields.

Modifies details like line items, customer information, addresses, and other attributes
for an existing draft order. Only non-read-only fields can be updated. When updating line items,
both product_id and variant_id are required for each item. The function supports deep merging
for nested objects like addresses and customer information.

draft_order_id.description: The unique identifier of the draft order to update.

draft_order.description: Input model for the draft_order parameter in shopster_update_a_draft_order.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer associated with the draft order.

note.description: Optional note attached to the draft order.

tags.description: Comma-separated list of tags for filtering and searching.

tax_exempt.description: Whether taxes are exempt for the draft order.

shipping_address.description: Input model for address in draft order update.

phone.description: Phone number associated with this entity.

address2.description: Secondary address line for apartment or suite numbers.

billing_address.description: Input model for address in draft order update.

phone.description: Phone number associated with this entity.

address2.description: Secondary address line for apartment or suite numbers.

line_items.description: A list of line item objects. Each item requires both product_id and variant_id.

items.description: Input model for a line item in draft order update.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the parent product. Required for updates.

variant_id.description: The unique identifier of the product variant. Required for updates.

title.description: The display name of the line item.

quantity.description: The number of units for this line item. Must be a positive integer.

price.description: The unit price as a decimal string. This field is read-only and will be ignored if provided. The price is always fetched from the product catalog in the database for security.

applied_discount.description: Applied discount for a line item in draft order input.

title.description: A descriptive name for the discount.

value.description: The discount amount as a decimal string.

value_type.description: Either 'fixed_amount' for dollar amounts or 'percentage' for percentage-based discounts.

custom_attributes.description: Custom attributes for the line item.

name.description: Property key for the line item.

key.description: Key for the custom attribute. Required field.

value.description: Value for the custom attribute. Required field.

value_type.description: Optional type information describing the value.

shipping_line.description: Input model for shipping line in draft order update.

title.description: The name of the shipping method (e.g., 'Standard Shipping').

price.description: The shipping cost as a decimal string.

customer.description: Input model for customer in draft order creation.

phone.description: Phone number associated with this entity.

id.description: The unique identifier of an existing customer. When provided, existing customer data is used.

email.description: The customer's email address for new customer records.

first_name.description: The customer's first name for new customer records.

last_name.description: The customer's last name for new customer records.

applied_discount.description: Input model for order-level discount in draft order creation.

title.description: A descriptive name for the discount.

description.description: Additional details about the discount promotion.

value.description: The discount amount as a decimal string.

value_type.description: Either 'fixed_amount' for dollar discounts or 'percentage' for percentage-based discounts.
